label: Ludwig Wittgenstein, A Lecture on Ethics LE…: Lecture on Ethics: the expression 'I wonder at the…
locator: LE it is nonsense to say that I wonder at the existence of the world
interpretation: 'it is nonsense to say that I wonder at the existence of the world, because I cannot imagine it not existing'; to wonder at something has sense only if I can imagine it not to be the case. Later: this experience 'is, I believe, exactly what people were referring to when they said that God had created the world'.
attribution: The passage states that 'I wonder at the existence of the world' is nonsense because one cannot imagine the world not existing, and that this experience is what people refer to by saying God created the world, which is the premise.
